facts.frontal-king: The king sits on the throne facing front.
facts.sword-right: In his right hand he holds a sword upright, tilted slightly.
facts.throne-butterflies: Butterflies and a crescent moon pattern are carved on the back of the throne.
facts.robes: He wears an orange cloak and a gray outer garment over blue clothes, and a crown.
facts.trees-birds: Trees and clouds stand on both sides, and two birds fly in the sky on the right.
facts.blue-sky: The background is a blue sky.

glosses.sword-right: A judgment that cuts according to principle.
glosses.throne-butterflies: A judgment built on thoughts that keep changing.

reversedGloss.excess: Logic and authority go too far, pressing down coldly.
reversedGloss.blocked: The judgment is clouded, and he cannot make a decision.
